# Q-MAM Library

This is a Python port of the Q-MAM (Queueing and Matrix-Analytic Methods)
toolbox originally implemented in MATLAB and located at
`matlab/lib/thirdparty/QMAM/` in the LINE solver repository.

Q-MAM provides matrix-analytic methods for solving structured Markov chains
arising in queueing theory, including M/G/1-type and GI/M/1-type processes.

## Origin

This code is a derivative work ported from MATLAB to Python for use in the
native Python implementation of the LINE solver. The original MATLAB source
is located at `matlab/lib/thirdparty/QMAM/` in the LINE solver repository.
